How the quiz picksSpaced recall

Six questions a day, drawn from every week up to your active one. Get one right and it moves to a longer box — 2 days, then 5, 12, 25. Miss it and it comes back tomorrow. Multiple choice is graded for you; recall questions you grade yourself against the model answer, honestly. Guessing right is not the same as knowing.
